items.title: City Poster Digital Art Prompt
items.prompt: A city rendering digital art poster for [{argument name="city name" default="city name"}]. The core subject of the image is a miniature island floating above white clouds, shaped like the selected city and occupying most of the frame. The shape of the island is similar to the city's map outline, seamlessly integrating the city's unique iconic landmarks, natural landscapes, and cultural elements. Include birds unique to the city, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, aerial perspective, and sun reflection effects. Buildings should not be too numerous or dense. The island showcases a seamless blend of history and modernity. One part features the city's most representative ancient historical buildings; the other part smoothly transitions into the city's landmark buildings and skyline view. The island floats above a vast sea of clouds. The sea of clouds is rendered using the traditional art style of the city's cultural sphere. 3D text of the city's Pinyin or English name floats above the miniature island. This group of text acts like a miniature ecological device where ecology and culture coexist. Around the frame and the main subject, layer a minimalist, elegant information layout layer with the texture of a museum display panel. Primarily retrieve relevant city information, using classic serif fonts for main information and extremely fine minimalist sans-serif fonts for auxiliary data. In the corners of the frame, arrange the information like a classical atlas or a high-end magazine title page. Use serif fonts to label the city's geographical coordinates, alias, or founding year, and the current weather, serving as decorative background information. The overall layout uses extensive negative space, is restrained, clean, and balanced, as if appreciating a precious work of art. Style requirements: Octane Render, C4D, Isometric City, Micro World, Living Ecosystem, 8k Resolution. DreamWorks style, 3D modeling, delicate, soft light projection.
